scope: SPEC-16 M4 cumulative acceptance. Each required case is allocated once. `executed` means the named evidence runs on every CI push against the M1, M2 and M3 bundles of the same run; `ci-only` evidence cannot be produced by a local run; `specified` has no executed evidence yet. The checker is tools/check-materialization-m4.mjs; its report is M4-CUMULATIVE.json and REPORT.json.

evidence: M4-CUMULATIVE.capability: advertised-without-evidence, unverified-upper-witness, upper-witness-assignment, deleted-mixed-port, missing-recorded-build, stale-build and modified-replay-plan refuse against the real M1, M2 and M3 manifests
M4-CUMULATIVE: Elixir and Haskell stay not_implemented with no stages in every manifest
each runner: unsupported-stage and missing-stage-evidence negatives
M4-CUMULATIVE.threeSeeded: every required M1, M2 and M3 scenario has three validated mixed plans, repeats reported, each tower replayed byte-exactly
M4-CUMULATIVE.threeSeeded: every first and replay run executed each planned role on its planned witness and crossed witnesses; plan build ids equal the recorded builds
M4-CUMULATIVE.fixedRoutes: both fixed routes of each milestone executed for every required scenario, with records checked against the route

M4-CUMULATIVE.inventory: each milestone's REPORT and COVERAGE name every required case and variant as passed, from the pinned clean source, with every listed tower, refusal branch and fault branch retained
M4-CUMULATIVE.oracle: M1 envelopes, M2 final readbacks and M3 restore and read outcomes equal the shared goldens
M4-CUMULATIVE.replay: the M3 runner replays a retained scenario without a seed reroll; the intact bundle reproduces and a bundle with one changed recorded signature refuses with retained exact replay
M4-CUMULATIVE.capability: missing-recorded-build and stale-build refuse at the replay plan
M4-CUMULATIVE.integrity: every retained artifact hashes to its recorded digest
M1 runner receivingCorruption and the shared receiving-boundary negatives: noncanonical bytes, signatures, indices and tables refuse invalid-evidence
M2 runner corrupt-signed-delivery: an altered request signature refuses before dispatch

M3 runner receivingCorruption: a trailing byte and a flipped appearance-signature byte in an exported image refuse invalid-control at restore and invalid-evidence at readback, in both producer and consumer directions
M4-CUMULATIVE.oracle.wrongShared: all three cmd_gather_resolve_fresh towers report height 99 where the fixture specifies 42; agreement passes and the independent oracle turns all three red

M3 runner isolation: after tower 0 ran, its control image and source state change; towers 1 and 2 reproduce their recorded results in fresh directories, and a tower pointed at tower 0's directory is detected

ci-only: the materialization-m4 job needs the TypeScript, Rust, Haskell, Elixir, command, M1, M2 and M3 jobs of the same run; the checker requires every one of them to succeed on the checked-out commit
the TypeScript job carries docs and vector freshness; the M1 and M2 jobs carry packet structure, command contracts, the package graph and Rust boundaries; the command job carries the inventories

M2 MEASUREMENTS: the nested Bed fixture (32 plants, four buckets, 128 signed facts, two levels) and the 0/128/1024/4096/4097 source sweep, batch phases, both witnesses, each row with its exact phase set

M4 MEASUREMENTS-LIFECYCLE.nested: the same nested Bed fixture through install, equal-size replacement, fresh restore and fresh read, each step a cold boot, outcome and image equal to a hand-built oracle in both witnesses

M4 MEASUREMENTS-LIFECYCLE.rows: the same four phases across the source sweep; control, delivery and result bytes, wall time, strict signature verifications, source checks and peak memory, both witnesses
M4-CUMULATIVE.measurements: exact phase sequences, byte accounting equal between the witnesses, 4097 refused at install with zero source checks, and refusal probes for missing phases

MEASUREMENTS-LIFECYCLE.boundaries: the exact and one-over pairs for delivery bytes, artifact bytes and request pointers, the over-only limits and the four lifecycle over-limit steps, all shared vectors both witnesses execute
cases.remaining: Journal-backed published Plant and Bed counts and bytes, and the native or portable route choice, are owed at M5 before acceptance.
